method: Separate selectCandidateOrAstar point-policy API: validate/rank registered candidates by bounded model time; if none valid invoke unchanged unit-cost A* FIFO with explicit expansion cap. Only A* graph exhaustion yields UNREACHABLE; nonempty frontier at cap yields BUDGET_EXCEEDED. Success is ROUTE_FOUND. Failure path empty/time null. Fallback A* minimizes moves, not bounded time; browser/core defaults unchanged.
checks: Commit choice/source/new10tests/wrapper/config/protocol before checks. Run every tracked root test/*.test.mjs once and archive a new TAP; unrelated untracked portfolio excluded.

Import practice17 once for four configured policy invocations. Record per-case family validation/timing, A* calls/expansions, selected source/path/time and failure reason separately. Regression planner calls are not these control counts.

Independently check all candidate partitions and valid timing formulas. Run Python unbudgeted BFS once per unique point layout (three maps) to distinguish reachable-budget failure from disconnected graph, compare successful path lengths, and verify returned point paths.

Check success profile formulas/rest/caps/continuity/schedules/64-panel integrals. Validate no A* call when a valid family member exists and no model time for invalid/failed outputs. Match historical known-case anchors.
Preserve old model/core/test/data/TAP bytes and freeze new evidence under new names. No comparative work/runtime improvement, global time optimum or physical claim from policy selection.
scope: Student selected offered policy; AI code/maps/limits/test/reference operation and interpretation. Known point controls, not new independent map cohort, wheel/body/swept collision/calibration/controller/runtime/energy validation or A*versusGreedy comparison.
